limitations: The saved E3 audit contains aggregate qualifying edge counts, not support counts for each individual edge.
Consequently, this analysis cannot conclusively attribute a lost gold consequence to the support of its exact cause-to-deviation or deviation-to-consequence edge.
Predictions disappearing after filtering do not by themselves establish whether those predictions were correct or incorrect.
The reconstructed dataset provides silver labels, not expert-validated causal ground truth.
